notes: correctToolMultiplier is 2x for every node when the equipped tool matches requiredTool — the tool never changes hit count, only yield per hit (verified in game.js: node.health -= 1 per hit regardless of tool; yieldForHit() doubles the resource amount).

hemp and berry_bush originally never respawned in the web game due to a bug (they were missing from the respawn whitelist even though respawnObject fully supported them) — that bug has since been fixed there. Port the FIXED behavior: both respawn normally, same as every other node.
